create_VisionTransformer: create a VisionTransformer model with configurable image size, patch size, embed dimension, and depth
build_vit_large: build a vit_large VisionTransformer model with 1024 embed dim, 24 layers, and 16 attention heads
run_vit_forward: run a VisionTransformer forward pass on image or video tensors with optional patch masking
test_vit_interpolate_pos_encoding: test the VisionTransformer interpolate_pos_encoding method for resizing positional embeddings
summarize_VIT_EMBED_DIMS: summarize the VIT_EMBED_DIMS mapping of model names to their embedding dimensions
